user.title: Connect to Tellybox
user.description: Enter the address of your Tellybox server and the read-only token from Installation settings, Home Assistant.

data_description.url: The address you use to watch Tellybox, for example http://192.168.1.50:8082.
data_description.token: Create or rotate this token at Tellybox Installation settings, port 8990. It is shown once.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the Tellybox token
reauth_confirm.description: The existing token was revoked, rotated or rejected. Enter the current token for this installation.

error.invalid_url: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS server address without a username, query or fragment.
error.invalid_token: Enter the token shown in Tellybox installation settings.
error.invalid_auth: Tellybox rejected this token. Create or rotate one in Installation settings.
error.cannot_connect: Tellybox could not be reached. Check the address, port and network.
error.invalid_response: This Tellybox server did not return compatible read-only statistics. Update the server.

abort.already_configured: This Tellybox installation is already connected.
abort.wrong_installation: This token belongs to a different Tellybox installation.
